skill.name: AI语音合成TTS - 聚合数据

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
AI语音合成（文本转语音）。将指定文本合成为语音文件并返回下载链接。使用场景：用户说"把这段文字转成语音"、"帮我生成一段语音"、"用甜美的声音朗读这段话"、"把这个文案合成音频"、"用英文女声读一下这句话"等。通过聚合数据（juhe.cn）API实时合成，支持多种拟人音色、多语言及方言，可选下载音频文件。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of juhe-speech-generate skill.

- Audio files can be downloaded and saved locally.
- Includes detailed setup instructions and user guidance.
- Lists all supported voice styles and languages for easy reference.
